description: One knowledge base the worker serves, as its health says it. `did` and `engines` are there while it is `working`, and only then.

state.description: `starting`: signing in, opening its stream, confirming it, or waiting to start again. `working`: confirmed, its engines claiming. `refused`: refused, until the service is started again.

did.description: The agent's DID at this knowledge base, as its gateway named it.

engines.description: One entry for each of the entry's engines, in its order.
